what: Check of results/anytwo_recal.json: ties at theta* and the A1 account split.
reading: Paging is strict (score > theta*). The honest calibration pages tie at the top any-two score in larger numbers than the budget allows, so theta* sits at the score ceiling and any-two at the matched budget pages nothing. A1's best any-two family scores below that ceiling: paging it would also page every honest calibration family scoring at least as much (the per-week rate above, against a budget of 1). So '0 vs 2,926' is not a threshold artefact: no any-two cutoff pages A1 within budget.
